title: Conormal comparison for restricted universal thickening
statement: For the open restriction data of a universal first order thickening, the restricted map is formally unramified and its conormal sheaf is canonically isomorphic to the restriction of the original conormal sheaf.

source.place: Stacks Project, More on Morphisms, Lemma 04FA and Definition 01R2

proof.text: Derive hV followed by the base open inclusion equals the original h after the source open inclusion, from the three given square equations and i followed by h'=h. Composition preserves formal unramifiedness, and Mathlib FormallyUnramified.of_comp cancels the base open inclusion, giving the required hVform. Take HV directly from hdata.

The two universal thickening witnesses imply that i and iV are closed immersions. Apply the proved open-kernel module lemma to their given preimage equality and commuting square. It identifies tensor pullback of the ambient kernel ideal along the ambient open inclusion with the restricted kernel ideal.

Identify source open restriction with tensor pullback by uniqueness of left adjoints to its pushforward. Rewrite successive tensor pullback along i and the source inclusion as pullback along their composite, transport through the square equality, and expand along iV and the ambient inclusion. Apply tensor pullback along iV to the kernel ideal comparison. Composition of these five module isomorphisms is the required conormal isomorphism by its definition.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 04FA (lemma-universal-thickening-localize), conormal restriction clause; Lemma 02HC (lemma-formally-unramified-on-opens); explicit tensor pullback composition and kernel restriction proof by G3

lean.statement:
theorem universalFirstOrderThickening_open_restriction_conormal
    {Z X Z' : Scheme.{u}} (h : Z ⟶ X) (i : Z ⟶ Z') (h' : Z' ⟶ X)
    (H : IsUniversalFirstOrderThickening h i h')
    (hform : FormallyUnramified h)
    {V : Z.Opens} {U : X.Opens}
    {hV : V.toScheme ⟶ U.toScheme} {V' : Z'.Opens}
    {iV : V.toScheme ⟶ V'.toScheme} {hV' : V'.toScheme ⟶ U.toScheme}
    (hdata : i ⁻¹ᵁ V' = V ∧ V' ≤ h' ⁻¹ᵁ U ∧
      iV ≫ V'.ι = V.ι ≫ i ∧ hV' ≫ U.ι = V'.ι ≫ h' ∧
      iV ≫ hV' = hV ∧ IsUniversalFirstOrderThickening hV iV hV') :
    ∃ (hVform : FormallyUnramified hV),
      ∃ (HV : IsUniversalFirstOrderThickening hV iV hV'),
        Nonempty
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).obj
              (@formallyUnramifiedConormal _ _ _ h hform i h' H) ≅
            @formallyUnramifiedConormal _ _ _ hV hVform iV hV' HV)
